sprint: World-Owned Text Quick-Edit Popup — Compact 2-Column Layout, No Scroll
task: Direct, screenshot-driven follow-up to the just-shipped Text object build: 'the implementation is clean, the UI is not. all options are not visible. scroll is needed but i dont want to put scroll. need alternative way for the context menu so that it does not looks cramped, options are visible, scroll is last way out.' Root cause: the popup stacked all 9 controls one per row inside a 230px-max-width strip, running off the bottom of a realistic browser window with no scrollbar to reveal it. Fix mirrors World Builder's own established _fieldRow()/_buildFieldGroup() pairing convention: js/contextPanel.js's _makeRangeRow/_makeSelectRow/_makeIconChoiceRow all gained an optional-append mode (parent=null just builds and returns the row), a new _makeColorRow was factored out of previously-inline duplicate code, and a new _pairRow(container,cellA,cellB) helper lays two short field rows side by side on one shared line -- a lone cell spans the full width when there's no partner, never left half-empty. _appendWorldObjectEditControl's text branch now builds Rotation first (order-independent, since it may or may not have a Colour row to pair with depending on the editable/moveable guardrail split), then pairs Font Family|Weight, Style|Alignment, Font Size|Opacity, and finally Colour|Rotation -- reducing the popup from 11 stacked blocks to 7. css/style.css widened .selection-action-strip's max-width (230/280px -> 300/340px, safe since _positionWidget() already re-measures and falls back correctly if it doesn't fit either gutter) and added a genuine last-resort safety net (max-height + overflow-y:auto, confirmed via an extreme 1366x380 viewport to degrade gracefully, never actually engaging at any realistic size) plus the new .context-field-row pairing CSS. Verified via a new 24-assertion Playwright suite at three realistic viewport sizes including one matching the reported screenshot's own proportions -- zero page-level scroll, all 9 controls genuinely visible, popup never overflowing, and the pre-existing 'never overlaps the canvas' invariant still holding at the wider size -- plus a zoomed screenshot confirming the clean 2-column layout. Full regression across text_object_full_build_check.js (26/26), selection_action_strip_test.js (15/15), selection_strip_pencil_fix.js (18/18), repaint_fix_verify.js (8/8), canvas_click_visual_repro.js (6/6), paperbg_hittest_repro.js (3/3), commitments_test.js, sync_charm_test.js, and text_resize_grid_test.js (13/13) all pass unchanged. Both goldenBuild.js suites pass unchanged -- zero Builder-tooling impact. Confined to js/contextPanel.js and css/style.css.
